purpose: Freeze corrected Phase-C seed-0 replay comparison semantics using only pre-outcome source/config/protocol identities and the Phase-C dependency map. This contract adds no new diagnostic exclusions and does not implement or modify comparator code.

replay_equivalence_protocol.governing_rule: all fields remain fail-closed except the already-frozen Phase-A runtime diagnostic projection and Phase-B timing projection; no additional exclusion may be added after fresh replay outcomes are inspected

governs: the already-frozen Phase-B maintenance-record timing projection only

attempt_json.primary_config_manifest_sha256_rule: must equal the corresponding accepted/fresh validated correction-config manifest SHA-256 before projection

raw_integrity_verification_order: verify payload_sha256 as the canonical SHA-256 of the raw JSON object without payload_sha256 but including summary_sha256
verify summary_sha256 as the canonical SHA-256 of the raw JSON object without payload_sha256 and summary_sha256
verify seed equals 0 and arm equals the filename/expected arm
verify primary_config_manifest_sha256 binds to the corresponding validated correction config
verify phase_b_arm_manifest_sha256 binds to the corresponding validated Phase-B seed-0 arm manifest
verify shared_identity_sha256 binds to the exact validated Phase-A seed-0 shared identity
verify maintenance_summary equals the corresponding raw Phase-B arm maintenance_summary within the same accepted/fresh tree
verify prediction_trace descriptor and referenced bytes/content under the prediction_trace contract
evaluation_json.projected_equality_rule: after only the inherited six Phase-B maintenance timing fields are removed and the two validated transitive identity fields are normalized, accepted and fresh evaluation JSON must be exact recursively equal and have identical canonical JSON SHA-256

metrics.comparison: exact recursive JSON equality for every weight/domain/metric; no tolerance, rounding, recalibration, recomputation substitution, or endpoint relaxation

explanations.comparison: exact recursive JSON equality; null-vs-value differences fail closed

primary_windows.comparison: ordered arrays and every field exact

diagnostics.diagnostic_exclusion_note: These scientific/operational diagnostics are not runtime diagnostics and receive no exclusion. The only Phase-C field removals are the already-frozen Phase-B timing fields copied into maintenance_summary.

retention_probes.comparison: ordered list, checkpoint identities, publication clocks, metric key set, and every numeric value exact; no tolerance or diagnostic exclusion

raw_integrity_verification_order: verify payload_sha256 as canonical SHA-256 of the raw JSON object without payload_sha256 but including manifest_sha256
verify manifest_sha256 as canonical SHA-256 of the raw JSON object without payload_sha256 and manifest_sha256
verify primary_config_manifest_sha256 binds to the corresponding validated correction config
verify phase_a_run_manifest_sha256 binds to the corresponding validated Phase-A seed-0 run manifest
verify phase_b_seed_manifest_sha256 binds to the corresponding validated Phase-B seed-0 seed manifest
verify arm_summary_sha256 has exactly the three frozen arm keys and each value equals that tree's raw evaluation summary_sha256
phase_c_seed_manifest.projected_equality_rule: after only the validated transitive identity fields above are normalized and the two verified self-hash fields are removed, accepted and fresh seed manifests must be exact recursively equal and have identical canonical JSON SHA-256

arm_summary_identities.rationale: raw summary identities may differ only because validated correction-config/Phase-B transitive identities and the already-frozen six Phase-B timing summary fields can differ; projected evaluation content must nevertheless be exact
normalization_allowed_only_after: inherited Phase-B timing projection is applied

allowed.treatment: verify raw, then remove after correction-config binding and config identity normalization
verify raw, then remove because it transitively covers fields already validated/projected
verify against own validated correction config, then normalize as transitive identity
verify against own validated Phase-B arm manifest, then normalize as transitive identity
verify raw, then remove because it transitively covers validated/projected fields
verify against own validated correction config, then normalize
verify against own validated Phase-A seed-0 manifest, then normalize
verify against own validated Phase-B seed-0 manifest, then normalize
verify against each own-tree raw evaluation summary_sha256; normalize only after corresponding projected evaluation equality passes

implementation_boundary.required_next_step: audit existing comparator against this frozen standalone contract before any historical corrected Phase-C seed-0 replay outcome is inspected; any implementation correction must tighten conformance only and may not add exclusions

direct_transitive_dependencies.primary_config_manifest_sha256: fresh corrected Phase-C binds to the regenerated validated correction config, so this identity may differ across accepted/fresh trees after scientific-block equality is established

derived_hash_dependencies.payload_sha256: write_json_new hashes the attempt object containing primary_config_manifest_sha256; verify raw integrity first, then remove only after the config identity is bound and normalized

direct_transitive_dependencies.primary_config_manifest_sha256: depends on the accepted/fresh validated correction-config identity
direct_transitive_dependencies.phase_b_arm_manifest_sha256: depends on the accepted/fresh validated Phase-B arm-manifest identity, whose raw hash may differ only through already-frozen Phase-B timing projections
direct_transitive_dependencies.maintenance_summary.compute_seconds_per_: derived from inherited Phase-B timing-only compute_seconds
derived from inherited Phase-B timing-only compute_seconds

derived_hash_dependencies.payload_sha256: write_json_new canonical hash over the evaluation object after summary_sha256 has been inserted

dependencies.row_content: constructed from frozen Phase-A neural predictions/checkpoint identities, frozen Phase-B symbolic trajectory/rule-version identities, frozen fusion thresholds, and the corrected Phase-C source
dependencies.raw_gzip_bytes: deterministic GzipFile filename='', compresslevel=9, mtime=0 over canonical compact sorted-key JSONL

direct_transitive_dependencies.phase_a_run_manifest_sha256: accepted/fresh validated Phase-A seed-0 run-manifest identity; raw hash may differ only through the already-frozen Phase-A runtime diagnostic projection
direct_transitive_dependencies.phase_b_seed_manifest_sha256: accepted/fresh validated Phase-B seed-0 manifest identity; raw hash may differ only through the already-frozen Phase-B timing/transitive projection

phase_c_seed_manifest.arm_summary_normalization_precondition: each raw evaluation payload/summary hash and within-tree binding must verify, inherited Phase-B timing projection must pass, and accepted/fresh projected evaluation equality must pass before the corresponding arm_summary_sha256 can be normalized

historical_phase_c_dependency_map.governing_rule: Only identities proven to be transitive consequences of the already-frozen Phase-A runtime projection, Phase-B timing projection, or regenerated correction-config identity may be normalized after raw integrity and within-tree binding checks. Every prediction, metric, explanation, diagnostic, retention-probe value, trace identity/content, boundary/control field and endpoint remains exact and fail-closed.
